name: General LLM pool (llama-swap + vLLM, llm-gpu.pow)
purpose: the general model pool on llm-gpu.pow: llama-swap on :9292 starts models on request and unloads them after their TTL; general, vision, embed, OCR, Swift, Bonsai and Nanbeige pin host GPU1; only Flash Next may lease both GPUs after voice idle-offload confirms voice LLM weights are in host RAM
installedBy: hosts/gpu-195/install.sh (rootless podman quadlet, user powos, linger on)
autosleep: llama-swap ttl 600 s per model (the proxy stays up, ~30 MB RAM, no VRAM); Swift trial TTL 300 s; Bonsai TTL 300 s
gpu: nvidia.com/gpu=0,1 (Flash Next leases both only while voice LLM is idle/offloaded; all other models pin host GPU1)
vramBudget: 19.7g (general or vision 0.70 + embed 0.10 or ocr 0.12 of 24 GiB; stt-batch holds the other 2.4); Swift alone uses 0.86 (~20.6 GiB), never beside other pool models; Bonsai alone ~9 GiB measured at 32k (GPU1 total ~11.4 GiB with stt-batch); Flash Next ~21 GiB plus stt-batch, ~37 GiB host RAM

keep: /var/lib/powos/models/hf (Qwen3-14B-AWQ ~10 GB, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-AWQ ~6.5 GB, bge-m3 ~2.3 GB); Swift W4A16 ~19.6 GB; Bonsai PQ2_0 ~7.2 GB
/var/lib/powos/models/strata (pinned Flash Next weights, draft layer, packs and Huihui vector)

vramNote: GPU1 shared with stt-batch; Flash Next may lease GPUs 0+1 only when the gateway confirms voice LLM weights are offloaded to host RAM
